lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good morning Andre! Thanks for picking up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, that sounds good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not bad. Sleeping better.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So did you manage to cook at home 4 nights?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, better than I thought. 4 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You figured that out on your own.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, but you don't know my schedule.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Healthy food costs a lot.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, I need to get my sugar down. At least I'm trying.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Cooking a big pot on Sunday can cover two or three dinners.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is anyone else at home able to cook?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. I can cook on Sunday and have it for a few days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you cook on Sundays?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to feel like yourself again.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let's put you down to cook at home 3 nights next week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, but you don't know my schedule.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 8 and not a 5?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 4 out of 4 days, the hard part was the cost, and next week you're going to cook at home 3 nights. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

tags.note: Reports 4 days of home cooking; ability.
Pushback on coach's understanding of schedule.
Unprompted cost claim; not raised by participant.
Wants to lower blood sugar; trying.
Adds motive not voiced by participant.
Feels better about self when sticking to plan.
Plans to cook Sunday for several days.
Wants to keep up with grandchildren.

flags.reason: 'You have to make this a priority' is a directive given without permission, right after participant reported success.
Coach set the next-week goal (3 nights) unilaterally instead of collaborating; participant objected in line 45 and it was not revisited.
Participant's schedule concern (sustain talk) was repeated and not explored; coach moved on to confidence scaling.
Participant asked to move the next call later due to an appointment; coach ignored the request and ended the call.

score.summary: The coach reviewed the prior week and elicited several good change statements, including the Sunday batch-cooking plan and the phone alarm. However, the coach used directives ('You have to make this a priority') and set the next goal unilaterally, which reduced partnership and left the schedule objection and reschedule request unaddressed.
strengths: Line 8: reviewed last week's goal with a clear closed question.
Line 24: asked permission before sharing the batch-cooking idea.
Line 36: emphasized autonomy with 'It's your plan.'
Line 49-50: reflected the participant's confidence rationale and summarized accurately.
coaching_tips: Line 11: replace 'You have to' with a question, e.g., 'What would make cooking at home feel doable for you?'
Line 44: offer the 3-night goal as an option and ask what the participant thinks is realistic before setting it.
Line 45: explore the schedule concern with an open question rather than moving on.
Line 53-54: acknowledge the appointment request and confirm a new time before closing.
